limitations: Typed implementation of both impact-price walks and premium arithmetic; logical valid maps, supplied native level visitation order and acyclic pool chains are premises.
Native tree/ring physical iterators, IndexMap allocation/hash layout, BTreeSet node layout and concurrent storage are not implemented; they are not replaced by precomputed impact prices.
Saturating continuation assumes diagnostic helpers return. Fault is an owned classification, not a native error/panic ABI; cycles are rejected defensively outside native terminating inputs.
Positive integer-scaled inputs make the native overflow-safe midpoint alternate unreachable; non-finite input payloads are not part of this API.
No captured target execution or emulation, network, live book access, signing or chain action. Issue and component gates remain incomplete.
